title: Tiny, cute train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Rails -->
  <rect x='2' y='82' width='96' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a8fa8'/>
  <rect x='2' y='88' width='96' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9aabbf'/>
  
  <!-- Track ties -->
  <rect x='10' y='78' width='4' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c9a06a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='78' width='4' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c9a06a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='78' width='4' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c9a06a'/>
  <rect x='64' y='78' width='4' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c9a06a'/>
  <rect x='82' y='78' width='4' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c9a06a'/>
  
  <!-- Train body (locomotive) -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='58' height='30' rx='6' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <!-- Lighter front edge -->
  <rect x='66' y='48' width='12' height='30' rx='5' fill='#ff7b6e'/>
  
  <!-- Cab roof -->
  <rect x='24' y='40' width='28' height='12' rx='4' fill='#d63530'/>
  
  <!-- Cab window -->
  <rect x='30' y='43' width='10' height='8' rx='2' fill='#7fe7ff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='43' width='10' height='8' rx='2' fill='#aaf3ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Boiler top detail -->
  <rect x='54' y='46' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff9a8a'/>
  
  <!-- Smoke stack -->
  <rect x='56' y='30' width='8' height='18' rx='2' fill='#d63530'/>
  <rect x='53' y='26' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff7b6e'/>
  
  <!-- Cow catcher / front -->
  <polygon points='72,78 86,78 82,68 74,68' fill='#ffb74d'/>
  
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='78' r='8' fill='#3a5a8c'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='78' r='4' fill='#7fe7ff'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='78' r='2' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  
  <circle cx='54' cy='78' r='8' fill='#3a5a8c'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='78' r='4' fill='#7fe7ff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='78' r='2' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='6' fill='#3a5a8c'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='3' fill='#7fe7ff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  
  <!-- Connecting rod -->
  <rect x='34' y='76' width='38' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c4d6e8'/>
  
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='58' r='5' fill='#fff176'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- Smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='20' r='6' fill='#c4d6e8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='14' r='4' fill='#d8e6f2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='10' r='3' fill='#e8f0f8' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Decorative stripe -->
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='54' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb74d'/>
</svg>
